plate_comment: The exhaust brake lockup aid (e2m RE_E_Brake_Inhibit_LU / RE_EB_Lockup_Range_* / RE_E_Brake_Inhibit_Timeout): the exhaust brake is held off until the converter locks. The rising edge of the converter clutch solenoid request (logical output 18) sets bit 0 of transmission_exhaust_brake_flags (cm848_updateEngineRetarderEnableState reads it as lockup disengaged). exhaust_brake_inhibit_timer counts down from exhaust_brake_inhibit_timeout (3 s). While the request is on and transmission_speed_ratio is inside the gear's window (exhaust_brake_lockup_speed_ratio_2nd / 3rd / 4th_gear_minimum / _maximum, around the gear ratios), bits 0 and 2 clear: lock confirmed, the exhaust brake may apply. In 1st they clear too. If the timer runs out first, it sets condition_eval bit 6 (the converter lockup inhibit / unlock request) and bit 2 (RE_Ebrake_Inhibit_Timeout_Flag). Called at the end of cm848_selectGovernorPressureLockupBoost (was cm848_updateExhaustBrakeLockupInhibit)
